audience: marketing and support teams who send SMS, WhatsApp and email and keep contacts in Bird

useCases.title: Check recent SMS and WhatsApp messages
useCases.text: The AI lists the newest inbound and outbound SMS or WhatsApp messages and opens single ones for their details. You can see what was sent and received.

useCases.title: Review sent emails
useCases.text: The AI lists the newest email messages sent from the workspace and opens one by id. You can check what went out and its details.

useCases.title: Look through audiences and the contacts in them
useCases.text: The AI lists your audiences, opens one and lists the contacts of a static audience. It can also show the custom contact-property definitions of the workspace.

useCases.title: Find message templates to reuse
useCases.text: The AI lists the SMS and WhatsApp templates available to the workspace, so you can pick the one that fits a customer message.

useCases.title: Look up contacts, add a contact or create an audience
useCases.text: The AI lists contacts or opens one by id, and creates a new contact with an email or a new audience. Neither action sends any message.
